subject: SIG/CAIQ submission: vulnerability management materials for SOC 2 window
messages:
From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence – vulnerability management (scan cadence, SLA, CVE closure)

Hi Hannah,

We’re updating our vendor SIG/CAIQ for an internal SOC 2 acceptance checklist and need a short package focused on vulnerability management. Specifically: scan cadence (static & dynamic), the remediation SLA policy for critical/high CVEs, and a signed CVE-closure declaration for any outstanding items in the last 90 days.

Can you provide a single package (attachments preferred) and a one-paragraph statement that we can keep with our control evidence? Our deadline is next Tuesday (2026-08-03 EOD PT).

Thanks — Claire
Claire Johnson
Senior Information Security Manager, Acme Corp
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence – vulnerability mgmt (deadline 8/3)

Folks — forwarding the customer ask. Goal: one consolidated archive with the items Claire listed plus a short sign-off paragraph we can send from security. Monica, can you pull the scan cadence summary and attach the remediation SLA doc? Vivek, can you confirm the CVE closure table and sign the closure declaration PDF? I’ll package and send to Claire once we have artifacts.

Quick constraints: the customer expects both SAST/DAST cadence and infra image scanning cadence. Call out frequency and responsible team, and an explicit SLA matrix (critical: 72h, high: 7 days, medium/low as standard). If we deviate from that phrasing, explain.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales (cc: Security for attestation)
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence – vulnerability mgmt (deadline 8/3)

Hannah — attaching the scan cadence summary (stubbed here as an attachment name). Notes:
- SAST (codebase): scheduled weekly incremental scans (critical paths daily incremental by PR hook); full repo baseline weekly.
- DAST (staging): nightly credentialed scans on canary/staging; full external scans weekly.
- Container/image scanning: build-time scan on every CI pipeline run; weekly fleet vulnerability sweep.
- Infrastructure (VM/host) scanning: agent-based daily checks with weekly authenticated scans.

I also pulled the remediation SLA document. Key policy bullets I recommend we surface in the paragraph:
- Critical CVE: target remediation or mitigated compensating control within 72 hours of detection.
- High: 7 calendar days.
- Medium: 30 calendar days.
- Low: triaged into normal release cadence.

Attached: redwood_scan_cadence_summary_Q2_2026.pdf; cve_remediation_log_2026-07-31.csv (draft). I flagged three CVEs from late June; Vivek, please confirm closure status and whether we need a formal signed declaration.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence – vulnerability mgmt (deadline 8/3)

Monica / Hannah — reviewed the CSV and the three items. Status: two CVEs (CVE-2026-1451, CVE-2026-1810) are fully remediated and verified in production as of 2026-07-29; one (CVE-2026-2102) was mitigated via a temporary WAF rule on 2026-07-27 and scheduled for code fix in the 2026-08-05 release (ETA confirmed).

I generated a short signed closure declaration (cve_closure_declaration_20260801.pdf) that lists the three CVEs, remediations, verification evidence references (internal ticket IDs), and my electronic sign-off as Acting Head of Platform Security. For SIG/CAIQ we typically include both the CSV log and the signed PDF.

Also confirming the SLA matrix Monica outlined is our published internal target. For customers we present the published SLAs as our standard and note that emergency escalations can shorten remediation windows with coordinated runbooks.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Acting Head of Platform Security, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ submission pack — vulnerability management (per your request)

Hi Claire — attaching the vulnerability management package for your SIG/CAIQ and SOC 2 evidence folder. Contents:
- redwood_scan_cadence_summary_Q2_2026.pdf (scan cadence across SAST/DAST/container/infra)
- cve_remediation_log_2026-07-31.csv (export of events and status)
- cve_closure_declaration_20260801.pdf (platform security sign-off on the three items flagged in June)
- sig_answers_redwood_2026-08-03.xlsx (worksheet with CAIQ/SIG answers populated)

One-paragraph control statement for your evidence binder:
"Redwood Inference maintains a continuous vulnerability management program spanning static and dynamic application scanning, container and image scanning at build-time, and agent-based host checks. Scans run on a daily to weekly cadence depending on asset class; our published remediation targets are 72 hours for critical CVEs and 7 calendar days for high-severity items, with verification evidence retained in internal ticketing. For the three items flagged in June 2026, Platform Security has provided remediation and verification artifacts as detailed in the attached CVE closure declaration (signed)."

If you need the declaration notarized or an additional letter on company letterhead, let us know and Vivek can route to legal/security for an authenticated copy.

Best — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_scan_cadence_summary_Q2_2026.pdf (PDF), cve_remediation_log_2026-07-31.csv (CSV), cve_closure_declaration_20260801.pdf (PDF), sig_answers_redwood_2026-08-03.xlsx (XLSX)
